While the dialogue is well-written and relies on effective subtext, the story contains several common creative writing clichés. These include the setting of a rainy train station café for a tense reunion, the trope of two estranged people meeting under the pretext of returning a borrowed item (the book) only for the owner to say "keep it," and the predictable, overused dialogue exchange of "Ich hätte anrufen sollen" ("I should have called") followed by "Ja. Hättest du" ("Yes. You should have").
